Great service and bread
Oct 2020 • Family
Being a Muslim family in HCMC we wanted to have something a bit different to the common halal options of Malaysian or Indian food so we decided to try Al Sham. The menu is extensive with something for everyone. I went with my husband and kids and they all enjoyed their food. 

We ordered lamb shwarma, and my 9 year old claimed it was the best he’s ever had, chicken shawarma, 11 year old said it was ok, chicken and chips, 6 year old said chips were great!

Husband and I shared some chicken livers and a bbq chicken. Everything was nice and prepared quickly. My only reason for taking one star off was that it was a bit bland for my palette. I like my food well seasoned but that’s just me everyone else loved it. 

Salim looked after us and he was very attentive.
